name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Tree Layout Reliability Patch
features: Fixed Talent Forge Tree mode reverting to cards when Blizzard reports missing or overlapping node positions
Added deterministic collision-safe placement while keeping available Blizzard row/column positions
Visually labels adjusted node positions and keeps original reported coordinates visible for comparison
Added regression tests for overlapping nodes, missing metadata and unique grid cells
Preserved existing Talent Path Intelligence, saved drafts, item research, Armory, Loot Hunter and Discord releases
No changes to the Cloudflare Worker or Blizzard credentials
